title: Solar Engine: Gear-Powered Light Harvester
description: The player operates an ancient solar engine where interlocking gears must be configured to channel divine light beams through a series of crystal lenses. Each gear controls rotation angle, speed, and lens tilt of a light path segment. The goal is to route godrays through all five collection nodes while maintaining total energy conservation across the system, with full undo/redo support for each adjustment.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that implements a gear-powered light harvesting puzzle. Load gears.glb and godrays_demo.glb using GLTFLoader from CDN. Scene setup: Place the godrays_demo model as a central radiant sun source elevated at Y=8. Arrange 5 instances of the gears model in a semicircular arc at Y=0, each gear acting as a light redirector node. Camera: PerspectiveCamera at (0,10,18) looking at origin, with OrbitControls limited to 30-70 degree polar angle. Lighting: Ambient light 0.15 intensity plus a DirectionalLight matching the godray direction. Core mechanics: Each gear has 3 adjustable properties via mouse interaction: (1) rotation angle (click+drag horizontally on gear), (2) vertical tilt of an attached lens plane (-45 to +45 degrees, shift+drag), (3) gear speed multiplier (scroll wheel while hovering, range 0.5x-3.0x). Animate gears spinning at their set speeds. Render volumetric light shafts as semi-transparent cone geometries from the sun through each gear's lens, with direction determined by gear angle and tilt. Energy conservation law: Total system energy is fixed at 100 units. Each gear's energy equals speed multiplied by lens aperture. When one gear's energy increases, others must proportionally decrease. Display energy bars beside each gear. Multi-input coupling: Gears 2 and 4 are mechanically linked so rotating one inversely rotates the other. Gears 1 and 5 share a speed constraint where their combined speed cannot exceed 4.0x. Victory condition: All 5 light beams must hit glowing target spheres placed at specific positions behind the gears. Implement an undo/redo stack storing full state snapshots for every parameter change, accessible via on-screen buttons and Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y. Show a HUD with current energy distribution, step counter, and undo/redo buttons. Display a congratulations modal with particle effects when all 5 targets are illuminated simultaneously. Minimum 10 deliberate adjustments required to solve due to coupled constraints.
